reason: A DeepSeek Harness CompactionEngine that deterministically compresses agent context by pruning atomic history nodes from a reference graph while retaining recallable records.

summaries.zh: 这是一个为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的确定性上下文压缩引擎，通过引用图剪枝选择性移除历史原子，并支持召回被剪枝内容。
summaries.en: A deterministic DeepSeek Harness compaction engine that selectively prunes atomic conversation history using a reference graph and supports recalling pruned content.

capabilities: Deterministically prunes agent conversation history using reference-graph rules
Replaces selected history items with tombstones and maintains a pruning index
Provides recall tools to retrieve pruned history items
Integrates as a DeepSeek Harness CompactionEngine backend
